tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: `--bg`. App ground behind the stage (letterbox when the 9:16 lock leaves bars). `text` on it: 18.7:1.

tokens.name: stage
tokens.usage: Literal `#000` in source. Camera stage ground and the canvas fill under the video in every capture.

tokens.name: result-bg
tokens.usage: Literal in source. Full-screen result view behind the captured photo/video. `text` 19.5:1, `dim` 9.6:1.

tokens.name: sheet
tokens.usage: `--sheet`. Bottom sheet body behind the thumbnail grid. `text` on it: 11.4:1.

tokens.name: sheet-bar
tokens.usage: `--sheet-bar`. Sheet tab row (Reset · tabs · Close). `text` 14:1, `tab-ink` 9.1:1.

tokens.name: pink
tokens.usage: `--pink`. The one brand accent: active tab, active tool, shutter ring, selected frame border, stamp resize handle, primary Save button. As a 2px border on `sheet` (selected frame) it reaches only 2.5:1 — the selection also tints the well (`thumb-on-bg`). White text on it: 4.6:1 (passes AA at 14px, only just — keep it at 14px+ weight 500).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: `--line`. 1px outline of the secondary button (撮り直す) on `result-bg`: 2.7:1 — below the 3:1 control-border floor; kept as in source.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: `--text`. All copy: labels on the camera image (with a text shadow), sheet, result. Also the fill of `ctl` glyphs on `pink`/`danger`.

tokens.name: dim
tokens.usage: `--dim`. Result hint line (size · KB, save instructions) on `result-bg`: 9.6:1.

tokens.name: tab-ink
tokens.usage: Literal in source. Inactive tab labels on `sheet-bar`: 9.1:1.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: `--danger`. Stamp delete control (×) and, at 95% alpha, the error notice. White text on it: 3.7:1 — fails AA for the 12.5px notice copy; kept as in source.

tokens.name: rec
tokens.usage: Literal in source. Recording state: shutter ring while recording, REC pill. White 12px text on it: 3.7:1 — fails AA; kept as in source.

tokens.name: tool-surface
tokens.usage: Literal in source. White square of a top-bar tool button.

tokens.name: tool-ink
tokens.usage: Literal in source. Glyph on `tool-surface` (17:1) and on an active mode disc.
